infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Stride reads motion activity to show your daily step count.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Stride uses your location to map and measure walks that you choose to record.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Stride can continue recording an active walk when the screen is locked or another app is open.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Stride to map and measure walks you record.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Stride to keep recording an active walk when the screen is locked.
